facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/state.c
facts.value: Desired render settings enter through HSD setup and HSD_StateSet* routines. The setters compare them with translation-unit-local cached values and forward only changed settings to GX before updating the cache. HSD_StateInvalidate routes selected HSD_STATE_* mask bits through a callback table; those callbacks clear subordinate HSD state or replace cached values with invalid sentinels, causing subsequent setters to emit the corresponding GX configuration again.
facts.reason: TU recheck: unconditional subsequent GX reapplication guarantee exceeds source behavior. Zero-sized primitive requests with preserved offsets can hit; enum selectors matching -1 are not rejected locally. Requires valid-domain qualification.
